title: Meeple Import Doctor
user: Board-game and vinyl collectors importing item URLs into a self-hosted catalog who need a clear answer when an external metadata scraper returns nothing.
smallest_useful_product: A browser-based URL inspector with pluggable public-page parsers that displays fetched status, detected fields, selector failures, normalized preview, and a copyable manual-import JSON record.
success_measure: In 80% of failed test URLs, the user can classify the cause as blocked, missing field, changed markup, or invalid URL in under two minutes.
constraints: Respect robots.txt, rate limits, and source terms; no credential collection or anti-bot evasion; parser output must attribute its source.
